content.value: A certain bearing is to carry a radial load of 500 lb and a thrust load of 300 lb. The load imposes light shock; the desired 90% life is 10 hr/day for 5 years at $\mathtt { n } = 3 0 0 0$ rpm. Select a deep-groove ball bearing. What is its bore?
